items.stem: Dr. Spock's baby-care book became popular partly because it coincided with
items.stimulus:
Questions 6–8 refer to the following excerpt (paraphrased).

Dr. Benjamin Spock's Baby and Child Care (1946) reassured parents that child-rearing was a natural process: trust your instincts, the book counseled, for 'you know more than you think you do' — a permissive message that resonated with a generation raising children in unprecedented prosperity.
—After Dr. Benjamin Spock, Baby and Child Care, 1946
